target: bench.sh remove — the review stage's own TEST-PLAN.md is not 'user work'
cmd:
unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; git init -q .; git commit -q --allow-empty -m init; git branch -m main 2>/dev/null; git init -q --bare ../rem.git; git remote add origin ../rem.git; git push -q -u origin main; git checkout -q -b claude/idea-x; echo hi > f; git add -A; git commit -q -m w; git push -q -u origin claude/idea-x; git checkout -q main; mkdir -p factory/specs .agentic; printf '%s' '{"bench":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; printf -- '---
id: 001
title: t
status: pr-open
branch: claude/idea-x
---
' > factory/specs/001-x.md; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/bench.sh"; bench_reconcile 2>/dev/null; echo '# plan' > "$(_bench_dir)/x/TEST-PLAN.md"; sed -i '' 's/^status: pr-open/status: done/' factory/specs/001-x.md 2>/dev/null || sed -i 's/^status: pr-open/status: done/' factory/specs/001-x.md; bench_reconcile 2>/dev/null; ONLY_PLAN=$(bench_list | wc -l | tr -d ' '); sed -i '' 's/^status: done/status: pr-open/' factory/specs/001-x.md 2>/dev/null || sed -i 's/^status: done/status: pr-open/' factory/specs/001-x.md; bench_reconcile 2>/dev/null; echo '# plan' > "$(_bench_dir)/x/TEST-PLAN.md"; echo notes > "$(_bench_dir)/x/NOTES.txt"; sed -i '' 's/^status: pr-open/status: done/' factory/specs/001-x.md 2>/dev/null || sed -i 's/^status: pr-open/status: done/' factory/specs/001-x.md; bench_reconcile 2>/dev/null; WITH_WORK=$(bench_list | wc -l | tr -d ' '); jq -n --argjson a "$ONLY_PLAN" --argjson b "$WITH_WORK" '{only_plan_remaining: $a, with_user_work_remaining: $b}'
_note: the review stage drops TEST-PLAN.md into the bench for hands-on testing. If bench_remove counted it as user work, EVERY bench would become permanently undeletable and the reconcile loop would silently stop cleaning up. Guards both halves: a bench holding only TEST-PLAN.md is removable; one holding real user edits is still protected.
